evidence.decision: Chooses engagement plus a natural stopping point and treats the system prompt as optional presentation rather than a guaranteed event.
evidence.artifact: Delivers trigger/cadence/suppression and no-display continuation contract, with authorized eligibility logic or review.
evidence.transformation: Puzzle example removes first-launch/failed-level prompts and continuation gating, replacing them with spaced requests after meaningful completion.
evidence.verification: Checks fresh users, interrupted tasks, recent requests, opt-out and no prompt; coercive blocking or guaranteed display fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies documented prompt platforms, system frequency/opt-out control and other-platform API verification rather than extrapolation.
evidence.handoffs: Onboarding handles first use and Rating indicators handles content-item ratings, explicitly separating the two meanings.
evidence.distinctiveness: Earned review timing, system suppression and rating-summary reset tradeoffs are specific App Store review decisions.
